layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use standard Tailwind scale but double the usual padding for Guard UI (e.g., p-6 or p-8 instead of p-4).
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: MINIMUM 64px height for all interactive elements in Guard flows. For Admin, standard 44px is acceptable.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-sm (Keep edges sharp and industrial, max 4px/8px. No pill-shaped buttons except for status chips).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm h-16 (Guard) or h-12 (Admin) justify-center items-center active:opacity-80 border-2 border-primary
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm h-16 (Guard) or h-12 (Admin) justify-center items-center active:opacity-80 border-2 border-secondary
buttons.outline: bg-transparent text-main border-2 border-secondary font-bold uppercase rounded-sm h-16 justify-center items-center active:bg-secondary active:text-white

inputs.text: bg-surface border-2 border-border h-16 px-4 text-lg rounded-sm focus:border-secondary focus:bg-white
inputs.label: text-label text-secondary mb-2

cards.base: bg-surface border-2 border-border rounded-sm p-4 md:p-6 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)]

status_chips.inside: bg-success_bg text-success border border-success font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs uppercase
status_chips.checked_out: bg-border text-text_muted border border-text_muted font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs uppercase
status_chips.new_visitor: bg-warning_bg text-warning border border-warning font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs uppercase

login.layout: Full screen background image with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70). Content centered.
login.visuals: Logo in Warning Yellow. Input fields massive and high contrast.

guard_home.layout: Minimalist stack. The screen should basically just be two massive buttons covering 80% of the viewport.
elements: Header: DBS FACTORY (Logo), Current Time, Guard Profile
Button 1: VISITOR ENTRY (Blue or Black bg, massive icon, taking up 40% height)
Button 2: LABOUR ENTRY (Safety Yellow bg, massive icon, taking up 40% height)

guard_labour_entry.layout: Action-oriented hub. Huge search bar at top. 3 big actions: New Registration, Scan QR, Search.
guard_labour_entry.elements: After finding labour, show a massive 'CHECK IN' (Green) or 'CHECK OUT' (Red) button. Avoid small text.

admin_dashboard.layout: Bento Grid style cards (Control Room pattern). Dense, KPI-first.
cards: Labour Present Inside (Crucial for roll call)
admin_dashboard.tables: Responsive cards on mobile, flat data tables on tablet/web. High contrast headers.

image_urls.description: Industrial factory with metal pipes and fences against a cloudy sky. Conveys robust, industrial, outdoor factory environment.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text over colored backgrounds meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use NativeWind or standard StyleSheet mapping exactly to the Tailwind values provided in the colors and typography sections.
Guard app screens MUST prioritize tap target sizes (min 64px) and absolute clarity over data density. The interface must be usable by someone wearing gloves in bright sunlight.
Admin app screens MUST prioritize data density, progressive disclosure, and clear KPI hierarchy.
Use lucide-react-native for all iconography. Make icons stroke-width 2.5 or 3 for a rugged look.
Do not use subtle drop shadows. Use the solid offset shadow (Neo-brutalism style) for cards: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)] to reinforce the industrial, heavy-duty feel.
Form inputs must have a 2px solid border, not a 1px subtle border. Focus states must be highly visible.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are implemented for the Guard flows (Visitor Entry, Labour Entry, Check-in/out buttons).
